summary: Lead management system with data uploads and Stripe payment integration
architectural_notes: Backend lead storage with CSV/Excel upload support
Dashboard for lead viewing and analytics

existing_features.title: Add bulk CSV/Excel file upload capability for importing leads into the system. The upload should validate required columns (name, contact, city, niche) and provide feedback on successful imports and any parsing errors.

Enhance the existing lead dashboard with comprehensive search and filtering capabilities. Users should be able to search leads by name, filter by status and niche, and manage lead data through the interface.
Integrate Stripe payment processing into the application. Users should be able to make payments for services, view payment history, and admins should be able to update payment status.

Create web forms for capturing new leads directly through the application. The form should collect essential lead information (name, contact, city, niche, status, revenue potential, owner) and save it to the backend.

new_feature_requests.summary: Lead database with CSV/Excel bulk data upload capability
Lead dashboard with search, filter, and management features
Web forms for capturing new leads
